payload.definition:
Scoped immutable state retaining attributable referents, preferences, lessons, applications and unresolved work for one participant and product.
Formal: S = reducer(previous, attributed event); scope and predecessor must match.
Domain example: An interrupted task retains its meaning; a different user cannot inherit it.
Counterexample: model confidence or silent user feedback establishes neither truth nor approval.
Source: cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/planning/interaction-context/PLAN.md; sha256=beb56657f2af30d230ea78268efe1fc7bf6bd6b63ab88affdf0408d76dc23d5b.
payload.plain_explanation: Keep what this interaction established without mixing people or products.
payload.boundary: Prototype meaning; no canonical promotion, automatic retention, permission or deployment.

payload.definition:
A bounded projection of applicable current interaction meanings into an existing Context Envelope.
Formal: V = select(S, request, policy); byte_size(V) <= budget.
Domain example: An explanation preference reaches an explanation request; obsolete wording does not.
Counterexample: model confidence or silent user feedback establishes neither truth nor approval.
Source: cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/planning/interaction-context/PLAN.md; sha256=beb56657f2af30d230ea78268efe1fc7bf6bd6b63ab88affdf0408d76dc23d5b.
payload.plain_explanation: Give the model useful selected meanings, not just hashes.
payload.boundary: Prototype meaning; no canonical promotion, automatic retention, permission or deployment.

payload.definition:
An evidence-bound assessment of a referent or interpretation as explicit, inferred, contested or unresolved.
Formal: Grounding requires exact source role, request identity and evidence span; confidence alone is insufficient.
Domain example: A user correction can bind the page; a quoted instruction cannot.
Counterexample: model confidence or silent user feedback establishes neither truth nor approval.
Source: cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/planning/interaction-context/PLAN.md; sha256=beb56657f2af30d230ea78268efe1fc7bf6bd6b63ab88affdf0408d76dc23d5b.
payload.plain_explanation: Record why a reference is supported or still unclear.
payload.boundary: Prototype meaning; no canonical promotion, automatic retention, permission or deployment.

payload.definition:
A source-bound scoped instruction about expression for an audience and output target, with exclusions and explicit or inferred posture.
Formal: P = (owner, product, interaction, target, applicability, source, revision).
Domain example: Diagram-first explanation does not force diagrams into source code.
Counterexample: model confidence or silent user feedback establishes neither truth nor approval.
Source: cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/planning/interaction-context/PLAN.md; sha256=beb56657f2af30d230ea78268efe1fc7bf6bd6b63ab88affdf0408d76dc23d5b.
payload.plain_explanation: Retain a style only where it applies.
payload.boundary: Prototype meaning; no canonical promotion, automatic retention, permission or deployment.

payload.definition:
A request-bound applicability judgment with applicable, inapplicable, overridden, disabled or unsupported posture.
Formal: Applicable iff scope, conditions, source and user policy match and current instructions do not override.
Domain example: An explicit prose-only request overrides a diagram preference.
Counterexample: model confidence or silent user feedback establishes neither truth nor approval.
Source: cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/planning/interaction-context/PLAN.md; sha256=beb56657f2af30d230ea78268efe1fc7bf6bd6b63ab88affdf0408d76dc23d5b.
payload.plain_explanation: Explain whether the preference belongs in this response.
payload.boundary: Prototype meaning; no canonical promotion, automatic retention, permission or deployment.

payload.definition:
An immutable record joining a reflection revision, later request, context, dispatch and attributable outcome evidence.
Formal: not-applied -> dispatched-awaiting-evidence -> supported|contradicted|inconclusive; a successor never mutates history.
Domain example: Dispatching a diagram lesson is not proof a diagram appeared.
Counterexample: model confidence or silent user feedback establishes neither truth nor approval.
Source: cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/planning/interaction-context/PLAN.md; sha256=beb56657f2af30d230ea78268efe1fc7bf6bd6b63ab88affdf0408d76dc23d5b.
payload.plain_explanation: Check whether a retained lesson reached the model and helped on that request.
payload.boundary: Prototype meaning; no canonical promotion, automatic retention, permission or deployment.

payload.definition:
A cohort-bound assessment of evaluated applications, failures, coverage and bounded improvement attempts.
Formal: Unique episodes; same metric/evaluator/baseline/policy; inconclusive is excluded from success denominators.
Domain example: Three attributable recurring failures can open one improvement target.
Counterexample: model confidence or silent user feedback establishes neither truth nor approval.
Source: cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/planning/interaction-context/PLAN.md; sha256=beb56657f2af30d230ea78268efe1fc7bf6bd6b63ab88affdf0408d76dc23d5b.
payload.plain_explanation: Measure progress and stop strategies that do not help.
payload.boundary: Prototype meaning; no canonical promotion, automatic retention, permission or deployment.

payload.definition:
A versioned specialization of Intent Reflection carrying corrected interpretation, scope, evidence, expected benefit, falsifier and retention controls.
Formal: Lesson inherits reflection provenance; revisions and revocations are append-only.
Domain example: A new preference is not evidence the engine previously misunderstood.
Counterexample: model confidence or silent user feedback establishes neither truth nor approval.
Source: cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/planning/interaction-context/PLAN.md; sha256=beb56657f2af30d230ea78268efe1fc7bf6bd6b63ab88affdf0408d76dc23d5b.
payload.plain_explanation: A correction may become a scoped lesson if the user permits its application.
payload.boundary: Prototype meaning; no canonical promotion, automatic retention, permission or deployment.

payload.definition:
The connected interpretation, action, observation, correction, later application and measured evolution cycle.
Formal: Missing evidence -> inconclusive; repeated no gain -> stop/research; upgrades remain recommend-only.
Domain example: A mock experiment proves wiring, not real-world benefit.
Counterexample: model confidence or silent user feedback establishes neither truth nor approval.
Source: cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine/planning/interaction-context/PLAN.md; sha256=beb56657f2af30d230ea78268efe1fc7bf6bd6b63ab88affdf0408d76dc23d5b.
payload.plain_explanation: Repair now, learn carefully, and test the next improvement.
payload.boundary: Prototype meaning; no canonical promotion, automatic retention, permission or deployment.
